Name: Account & Territory Management
Description:
Manages the lifecycle, alignment, and core attributes of HCP and HCO accounts to ensure accurate targeting and compliance.

* Automatically populates target owners on Person Accounts based on territory associations.
* Calculates and assigns primary territories and field ownership using direct sales alignments.
* Assesses HCP specialties and credentials to automatically allocate appropriate record types.
* Oversees postal alignments and synchronizes address statuses with parent accounts.
* Tracks contact consent indicators and automates do-not-call flags based on expired permissions.
* Updates Key Opinion Leader (KOL) attributes on accounts following MSL interactions.
Primary Objects: Account, Account_Territory_Loader_vod__c, Zip_to_Terr_vod__c, HYB_SymphonyData__c, HYB_Inclusion_Specialty_CNX__c, HYB_Excluded_Specialty_CNX__c, Address_vod__c, Multichannel_Consent_vod__c, User, Call2_vod__c

Name: Event & Attendee Management
Description:
Provides end-to-end management of medical and commercial events, including speaker allocation and attendee registration.

* Provides a public-facing web portal for event attendees to register using unique codes.
* Validates attendee information (e.g., NPI, email) and prevents duplicate registrations.
* Formats and populates human-readable date and time strings for event records.
* Manages speaker allocations, validation rules, and dynamic manager assignments for events.
* Automates system default allocations for attendees and sends confirmation emails and reminders.
* Captures and saves attendee registration data into custom tracking objects.

Name: Partner Integration & Data Sync
Description:
Facilitates data synchronization with external partners for sample management and fulfillment.

* Systematically updates modification timestamps on Account and Address records.
* Enables differential data capture for the J. Knipper partner integration streams.

Name: Order & Sample Management
Description:
Manages ordering settings and enforces distribution limits for samples and educational materials.

* Assigns default order types based on target Account record criteria.
* Rolls up the quantity of educational materials (e.g., textbooks) delivered to accounts annually.
* Enforces business rules by automatically resetting distribution trackers at the start of the year.

Name: Public Site & Portal Infrastructure
Description:
Provides the foundational framework, user authentication, and error handling for public-facing Salesforce Sites and Portals.

* Establishes a global site template with consistent branding, headers, and footers.
* Manages self-registration, user authentication, password recovery, and Single Sign-On (SSO) matching rules for portal users.
* Enables authenticated users to securely update their profiles and change passwords via a self-service interface.
* Displays standardized error pages for 404 Not Found, Bandwidth Exceeded, and general exceptions.
* Provides standard landing pages for site maintenance and under-construction statuses.

Name: System Administration & User Access
Description:
Supports internal system administration, user access management, and UI navigation utilities.

* Implements Single Sign-On (SSO) auto-registration rules to match and link incoming users.
* Restores valid email schemas in sandbox environments to mitigate deliverability locks during testing.
* Embeds external Veeva CRM web modules (like Call Reports) into standard Visualforce pages.
* Facilitates visual navigation redirects for internal users accessing standard Ideas and Answers structures.

Name: Field Coaching Management
Description:
Manages the lifecycle and workflow of Field Coaching Reports (FCR) to support manager-to-employee coaching and performance tracking.

* Automates coaching report workflow logic and status progression.
* Copies previous performance metrics into new coaching reports to provide historical context.
* Locks historical coaching records upon completion to ensure data integrity.
* Triggers automated notifications to direct reports when coaching reports are approved.

Name: Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing
Description:
Facilitates internal user navigation and access to standard collaboration features such as Ideas and Answers, improving user adoption and experience.

* Provides visual navigation links and redirects to standard Salesforce Ideas lists.
* Directs users to standard Answers structures and tabs for knowledge sharing and community Q&A.

Name: Call Reporting Integration
Description:
Embeds external Veeva CRM web modules into standard Salesforce interfaces to provide seamless access to call reporting functionalities and a unified user experience.

* Acts as a bridge to embed Veeva CRM Call Reports directly within Salesforce Account and Visualforce pages.
* Handles background session authentication for seamless access to embedded external modules without multiple logins.
* Loads necessary dependencies and stylesheets to render external Veeva interfaces natively within Salesforce.

Name: Environment & Sandbox Administration
Description:
Provides administrative utilities to support development operations and sandbox environment management.

* Restores valid email schemas automatically in development and test sandboxes post-refresh.
* Mitigates email deliverability locks by rectifying system-appended '.invalid' email addresses automatically.
* Streamlines post-copy sandbox configuration tasks for administrators.

Name: Order Promotional Material Validation
Description:
Ensures compliance and accuracy during the order entry process by validating product combinations.

*   Validates order line items to ensure postcards are not combined with other promotional materials.
*   Automatically cancels irregular orders that violate promotional material combination rules.
*   Enforces isolation logic for specific product types within the order management process.

Name: Portal User Identity and Profile Management
Description:
Manages the lifecycle of portal user identities, ensuring secure access and self-service capabilities. 

Key functionalities include:
* Allows users to self-register for portal access.
* Provides secure login and authentication mechanisms.
* Enables users to recover forgotten passwords.
* Allows authenticated users to update their profile information and change passwords.
* Facilitates Single Sign-On (SSO) by matching incoming SSO assertions to existing user records.

Name: Public Site Experience and Error Handling
Description:
Provides the foundational user interface templates and standard error pages for public-facing Salesforce Sites, ensuring a consistent user experience. 

Key functionalities include:
* Establishes a consistent, branded layout for site pages using global templates.
* Displays user-friendly 'File Not Found' (404) error pages.
* Notifies users when site bandwidth limits have been exceeded.
* Presents custom exception and error messages gracefully.
* Informs users when the site is down for maintenance or under construction.

Name: System Administration and Environment Management
Description:
Provides utilities for monitoring organization health and managing sandbox environments to support ongoing system administration. 

Key functionalities include:
* Retrieves and stores current Salesforce organization storage limits (Data and File) on a scheduled basis.
* Assists in post-copy sandbox operations by restoring valid user email addresses to mitigate deliverability locks.

Name: Clinical Discussion Validation
Description:
Ensures data integrity and accuracy during clinical discussions by validating specific identifiers against active records.

* Validates input Hub IDs during clinical discussions to prevent data entry errors.
* Ensures that entered Hub IDs correctly correlate with active, mapped records in the custom Hub list.

Name: Medical Inquiry Management
Description:
Manages the lifecycle and tracking of medical inquiries submitted by users.

* Automatically populates the submission timestamp when a medical inquiry request is submitted.
* Ensures accurate tracking and auditing of medical inquiry workflows.

Name: Staff Contact Synchronization
Description:
Automates the creation and synchronization of standard Contact records based on custom staff entries to maintain organizational data integrity.

* Triggers automatically upon the creation of custom staff records.
* Migrates staff details directly into standard Contact records.
* Ensures proper organizational structures and data consistency across standard and custom objects.
